method: Arbitrary user-requested visual relocation to Northern Gyeonggi. No search, ranking, route study, or suitability analysis was performed.
selected_reason: Fictional scenario background only; coordinate supplied as a visual reference.

distant_departure.representation: Abstract schematic space beyond the local DEM; not North Korean terrain or a real cross-border route.

No cadastral, flood, obstacle, wind, land-use, construction, or military siting assessment.
